name: Chicken and Croutons
description: A creamy chicken casserole topped with Swiss cheese and crunchy croutons.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Rinse the chicken and pat dry, then arrange in a 9×13 inch baking dish.
Top each chicken fillet with a slice of Swiss cheese.
Combine the cream of chicken soup, mushrooms, and milk in a bowl; mix well.
Spread the soup mixture over the chicken.
Toss the croutons with melted butter in a small bowl.
Sprinkle the buttered croutons over the casserole.
Bake, covered with foil, for 1 hour.
Bake, uncovered, for an additional 15 minutes until the top is browned.

keywords: chicken casserole, croutons, creamy chicken bake

_similar.name: Stuffing and Chicken
_similar.description: A comforting chicken breast casserole with Stove Top stuffing, Swiss cheese, and cream of chicken soup.
recipeIngredient: 4 boned and skinned chicken breast halves

recipeInstructions.text: Place chicken breasts in a sprayed 8×8 inch casserole dish.
Put a slice of Swiss cheese on top of each breast.
Spread 1⅓ cups of dry Stove Top stuffing over the cheese.
Spread the cream of chicken soup over the stuffing layer.
Bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, stuffing, Swiss cheese, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Baked Cauliflower
_similar.description: A creamy baked cauliflower casserole with cheese, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cauliflower in boiling water and salt for 10 minutes.
In a casserole dish, stir together undiluted soup, cheese, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
Add cauliflower and mix well.
Toss bread crumbs in melted butter and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 250°F until bubbly.
